sources.note: JSPS official page: 'Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan — Short-term (PE), About the Program' (programme description, eligibility, financial support, contact block for Overseas Fellowship Division).
JSPS official page: 'Application Schedule (Short-term (PE) · Open Call)' with FY2027 and FY2026 recruitment deadlines.

awarding_body.detail: The page is JSPS's own site (jsps.go.jp) and the contact block names exactly the division recorded in the catalogue. It is not an aggregator or mirror.
awarding_body.quote: Overseas Fellowship Division International Program Department Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) Kojimachi Business Center Building, 5-3-1 Kojimachi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 102-0083, JAPAN

deadline.detail: Today (12 October 2026) the currently open cycle is the FY2027 2nd recruitment, with the application submitted by the Japanese host institution to JSPS by January 8, 2027, 5 p.m. JST; the FY2027 1st recruitment closed September 25, 2026, and the FY2027 3rd recruitment deadline is June 4, 2027, 5 p.m. JST — exactly matching the record. The deadline is a future date, so a cycle is currently open.
deadline.quote: 1st / September 25, 2026 (by 5 p.m. (JST)) ... 2nd / January 8, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)) ... 3rd / June 4, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST))

eligibility.detail: The record's core claims are confirmed exactly: candidates must be citizens or permanent residents of the listed North American and European countries (the page also allows researchers with 3+ years continuous research in those countries) and must have obtained a doctorate within six years as of April 1 of the fellowship's fiscal year, or be enrolled in a doctoral course expecting a PhD within two years of the fellowship start. Minor nuance: the page says 'citizen or permanent resident' rather than the record's looser word 'resident', and eligible countries include Russia.
eligibility.quote: (*) Eligible countries are the US, Canada, European Union countries, UK, Switzerland, Norway and Russia. ... have obtained a doctoral degree from a foreign graduate school and, As of April 1 of the fiscal year, are within six years of having obtained that degree (i.e., obtained their degree on or after April 2, six years prior to the fiscal year), or who are currently enrolled in a doctoral course at a foreign graduate school (equivalent to the doctoral level) and are expected to receive a Ph.D. within two years from the start date of the fellowship period.

funding.detail: The record's 'Stipend' funding type is accurate: the award is a maintenance allowance of JPY 362,000/month (PhD holders) or JPY 200,000/month (non-PhD holders when research starts), plus round-trip airfare, a JPY 200,000 settling-in allowance (tenures of 3+ months), and overseas travel insurance. It is not a tuition scholarship — it funds a short research stay (1–12 months) in Japan.
funding.quote: (1) Airfare: A round-trip air ticket (based on JSPS's regulations.) (2) Maintenance Allowance: (a) For PhD holders: JPY362,000 per month (b) For non-PhD holders at the time research starts in Japan: JPY200,000 per month (3) Miscellaneous: A settling-in allowance of JPY200,000 (only applicable for Fellows with 3 or more months of tenure), Overseas travel insurance, etc.

degree_levels.detail: The record's 'PhD, Postdoctoral' matches: the programme is open to PhD holders (postdoctoral researchers, within six years of the doctorate) and to enrolled doctoral-course students who expect a PhD within two years of the fellowship start.
degree_levels.quote: The program provides PhD students or PhD researchers in the Europe and North America with opportunities to conduct collaborative research under the guidance of their hosts in universities and other Japanese institutions for a relatively short period of time.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: FY2027 2nd recruitment application deadline (from host institution to JSPS): January 8, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)); FY2027 3rd recruitment: June 4, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)); FY2027 1st recruitment closed September 25, 2026
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Both the About-the-Program and Application Schedule pages read live on 2026-10-12 and match the record. Applications in the Open Call channel are submitted by the Japanese host institution to JSPS, not by the candidate directly; there is also a Nomination channel via overseas nominating authorities. Eligible countries listed: US, Canada, EU countries, UK, Switzerland, Norway and Russia. Fellowship duration 1–12 months; 20 awards per recruitment. Next re-check should confirm the schedule page after 2027-01-08 (2nd recruitment results publish mid-May 2027) and watch for FY2028 dates.
